up: Find compounds that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5728082' (i.e., from the docs table where chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL5728082'). For each such compound, return its ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), and its canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles). Include only compounds that have a non‑null canonical SMILES. Do not add any extra filters or row limits.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5728082' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL;
